# Auto-generated by @typecad/framework-zephyr from cuttlefish.config.ts.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

# The app is its own board root: MCU-only targets generate an out-of-tree
# custom board under boards/typecad/<name>/ that Zephyr must discover.
# Harmless when boards/ holds only .overlay files (BOARD_ROOT just needs
# the directory to exist).
list(APPEND BOARD_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})

project(zephyr_app)

# Cuttlefish-emitted sources. This list is regenerated whenever the
# emitted file set changes (the scaffold rewrites CMakeLists.txt).
target_sources(app PRIVATE
  src/__tc_rgbled.cpp
  src/src.cpp
)

# PSRAM enabled: activate the runtime PSRAM canvas paths.
target_compile_definitions(app PRIVATE BOARD_HAS_PSRAM)
